name: P5 small fixed-metric ablation v1
classification: Review-motivated prospectively frozen extension; not original confirmatory result
backend: JAX CPU float64, serialized after ULA baseline extension
selection: Stable complete settings only. Four-dimensional nondomination over warm,cold,SW2,variance; pick highest rank0 checkpoint count,lowest min rank,largest inverse-rank coverage,then smaller h. Up to1 step per CV method/batch and2 ULA steps per geometry. No refinement.

metrics.sw2: same approved target-specific whitening,projections and two reference clouds
metrics.variance: relative coordinate variance NRMSE from per-replica ergodic sums over steps1..K; no discarded burn-in, intentionally finite-horizon from-mode error

failure: Any failed replica, missing seed or incomplete run excludes complete configuration at all checkpoints; retain failed/censored records
cost: Same setup-inclusive CPU attribution. Diagonal metric assembly uses observationwise squared features O(Nd), applied elementwise O(d); full metric assembly/factorization and application recorded separately. CV2 still requires FULL likelihood Hessian correction even under identity/diagonal. Shared anchor fit, exact LP planning from frozen target Hessian and reference/scoring work disclosed separately; no whole-sampler O(d) claim.
scope: Compare optimized bounded grids per metric and method; matched seeds across geometry, but separately tuned parameters. Bands per geometry, not simultaneous across all geometries. Budget failures do not prove inaccuracy.
pre_run_source_lock_note: Fixed-input update checks call actual JAX metric_step versus independent NumPy; locked before any ablation runs.
